`tdx_quote*` and `tdx_quote*_collateral.json` are copied unchanged from
`dcap-qvl` 0.7.0 `sample/` (MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 Phala Network,
https://github.com/Phala-Network/dcap-qvl). They are real Intel-signed TDX
quotes with their DCAP collateral, used to test that genuine quotes verify and
that forged, foreign or outdated ones are refused.
